description.subject: A crocheted amigurumi doll made of cream and red cotton thread with a stuffed, stitched form and embroidered features.
description.covering: A red knitted coat with two gold-coloured buttons, ruffled cuffs and hem and an attached cowl-style hood, black-and-white striped leggings that reach the ankles, cream mitten-like hands, and glossy black wellington-style boots.
description.posture: Standing straight on both boots with arms angled slightly out from its sides, facing directly toward the viewer.
description.setting: Outdoors on a bed of smooth pebbles in pink, grey, tan and white, in front of a pale sage-green metal bucket and a weathered wooden fence.
description.light: Soft, diffuse daylight from the front with no hard shadows, and a warm, slightly muted colour.
description.anomaly: A white cord is looped from the doll's hood down its front to a glossy orange ball resting on the pebbles between the tips of its black boots.
